title: Planomy Tax Data Index
description: Manifest of the published dataset years.

x-provenance.note: Derived from the API Evangelist OpenAPI, which was itself written from live 200 responses at https://planomy.net/tax-data/. Planomy publishes a prose schema at https://planomy.net/data/#schema but no machine-readable schema.

latest.description: The most recent published tax year.

years.description: Every tax year with a published dataset file.

schema.description: URL of the prose field-level schema.

yearUrlTemplate.description: RFC 6570-style template resolving a year to its dataset URL.
